label: Simple priority is well-founded, from grounding well-founded on actual concreta
description: Non-transcription conditional derivation on one m and w, for the shared frame's simple-priority field F.PriorSimply (sense PRIOR_1). If grounding among actual concreta at w is well-founded (82cfaf26), whatever is simply prior to something other than itself is an actual concrete ground of it at w (86efed1a) and nothing is prior to itself (32d77f18), then simple priority is well-founded on the whole carrier (d85de8e1). Step: what is prior to x is other than x by irreflexivity, hence an actual concretum grounding x; well-foundedness transfers. The bound type is the unsplit PRIOR_1, and the support holds on only one of the two readings that type does not distinguish: on priority in being (what x depends on for its being) 86efed1a is positively supported; on priority in act in a respect it meets the hand-and-stick counterexample (causal-dependence-support-investigation.md (e), row 1). 86efed1a's own paraphrase records a second falsifier: a non-concrete or absent simply prior thing. The split is tested in specs/dependence-order-senses.toml: on PRIOR_4 (priority in being, already a sense) a weaker bridge among actual concreta carries well-founded grounding to PRIOR_4 among actual concreta, while this PRIOR_1 derivation keeps the counterexample to 86efed1a and its only consumer (e229bb2c) needs PRIOR_1. The existing chain from d85de8e1 to the secunda via premise 97f5850f (e229bb2c to 42890b45, then 438866fa with f10d5632) also needs the all-respects premise e078f07b, whose joint use with respect-free d85de8e1 is lane A's reciprocity case (row 21) and against which the hand-and-stick counterexample is kept; so this argument does not by itself carry well-founded grounding to the secunda via. The closed controls priorityControls give, for each input, a Bool interpretation in which the other two hold and priority is not well-founded (the irreflexivity omission is a self-loop, which the distinct-relata bridge does not see), and a nonvacuous interpretation.
